critical_distinctions.claim: MOSAIC aircraft-certification provisions effective July 24, 2026 allow eligible two-seat powered-lift a Part 22 / 21.190 light-sport special-airworthiness route; do not claim all personal powered-lift require conventional type certification.
The July 2026 FAA acceptance of ASTM F3840-26 covers powered-lift only at that time, not multicopters despite the standard title.
Aircraft light-sport certification does not create powered-lift sport-pilot privileges or general paid-passenger authority.
SFAR 120 / Part 194 concerns training and operations, not aircraft or landing-site approval; its stated expiration is January 21, 2035.
The powered-lift framework addressed here assumes onboard pilots; autonomous passenger operation is a separate unestablished scope.
Two-occupant mobility is not a Part 103 single-occupant sport/recreation ultralight.
Experimental authorization is limited by purpose and operating limitations; it is not ordinary air-taxi approval.
eIPP does not bypass certification; aircraft in the partnership must already be in the formal type-certification process. No participation is established for this concept.
FAA site/airspace review does not replace Caltrans permitting, local land-use approval or CEQA.

MOSAIC makes Part 36 noise compliance voluntary for light-sport aircraft; community noise and land-use constraints remain material. Do not apply the standard type-certification noise statement indiscriminately.

items: FAA airspace determination and relevant Part 157/77 process
Caltrans heliport permit unless a verified exemption applies
Building, fire, electrical and emergency-access review
Charging, downwash/outwash and community noise assessment
california_site_review.el_segundo_note: Do not assume the qualifying personal-use heliport exemption for unincorporated areas applies to El Segundo; do not assume LAX Class B access or approved corridors.

safety_gates.name: Mission and classification
safety_gates.evidence: Bounded intended use, configuration, site and approval-route assessment
safety_gates.stop_condition: Mission incompatible with viable regulatory route

safety_gates.name: Ground proof
safety_gates.evidence: Controlled demonstrator and occupant, braking, energy and interface-safety evidence

safety_gates.name: Aviation feasibility
safety_gates.evidence: Mass/energy budgets with reserves and degradation, hazard/common-cause analysis, assurance and support plans

safety_gates.name: Test readiness
safety_gates.evidence: Lawful test permissions, qualified team, facility access, independent safety review and acceptance criteria
safety_gates.stop_condition: Missing permissions or critical unresolved hazards

safety_gates.name: Approval and production
safety_gates.evidence: Chosen compliance route, quality/traceability, airworthiness, trained pilots, maintenance and site permissions
safety_gates.stop_condition: Any required approval or service capability absent

safety_gates.name: Controlled entry
safety_gates.evidence: Observed reliability, demand, service capacity and unit economics within approved limitations
safety_gates.stop_condition: Safety or reliability evidence insufficient for scale

fundraising_stages.status: Illustrative planning only; not quotes, securities offers, valuations or funding commitments

public_fundraising_caution.text: An unrestricted public website can constitute general solicitation, which Rule 506(b) prohibits. Choose a lawful offering route with qualified securities counsel before publishing investment terms, an offer or a fundraising campaign. A disclaimer alone is insufficient.
